svg.text: two Xtensa LX7 cores at 240 MHz, one chip
owns the WiFi radio and the 802.11 MAC
writes the flash when Linux asks
boots first and starts Linux on core 1

svg.text: dropbear or telnetd, cron, nano, curl

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 8 MB, all of it Linux RAM
128 pages of 64 KiB, mapped through the cache MMU. A context
switch between forked processes swaps whole pages by
rewriting MMU entries instead of copying them.
